You can add new (or change existing) file name patterns using the `--map-syntax`
command line option. The option takes an argument of the form `pattern:syntax` where

of passing it on the command line (see below).

Implemented `--ignored-suffix` support.

- Added repeatable `--ignored-suffix <suffix>` CLI option, also usable from `~/.config/bat/config`.
- Custom suffixes are stored in `IgnoredSuffixes` and applied alongside built-in backup/template suffixes during syntax detection.
- Validated `test.json.suffix`, `test.json~`, multiple config-file suffixes, and ran the full library + integration suites: all 117 tests pass.
